page.layout: One page of text. At the top, a block of four centred Arabic lines. Below it, one justified Latin paragraph, followed by one short right-aligned Arabic line at its foot. No margin notes, no catchword, no signature.

main_text.p: idest, Professio fidei Ecclesiae Apostolicae, quam scripsit S. Johannes Patriarcha Antiochiae in Monasterio Maronis sito ad flumen Hasi, (Latinis Orontes dicitur), Provinciae Apameæ, & Hemes eamque misit ad Montem Labanum, ex quo nominantur incolæ memorati Montis Maronitæ ex nomine Monasterii Maronis, & Joannes quoque ipse Maro nominatur ex nomine Monasterii. Ad hujus Monasterii judicium provocarunt nostri Syri, cùm propositum illius esset Monothelitarum dogma, testis est Thomas Caphortabensis Episcopus Tractat. 4. suarum dissertationum de voluntatibus Christi hisce verbis,

page.notes: The Arabic lines are printed in a larger, heavier type and are centred, so they are set apart as a quotation; the four lines are given as <l> entries. The first and second lines are uncertain at the start and near the right edge, and the word in the second line before the final word is hard to read; these are marked [?]. The final Arabic word of the last line is also uncertain. "Tractat. 4." sits within the justified line and is kept in the text. The Latin paragraph begins with "idest" and reads as a continuation of the quoted Arabic, not of the previous page. Long s is rendered as s throughout; the "f" forms are read as long s. The ornament after the fourth Arabic line is a printed symbol, not a letter.
